question: What was the month-over-month growth rate in order count from December 2017 to January 2018?
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-02-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur FROM orders o) SELECT (cur - prev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prev, 0) AS growth FROM m
notes: {"explanation": "Computed (orders in January 2018 - orders in December 2017) / orders in December 2017.", "assumptions": ["All order statuses", "Growth returned as a fraction"]}
